name: Conseil d'État, 24 November 2023 – Amis de la Terre (2023 penalty payment)

jurisdiction.court: Conseil d'État (French Council of State) – air quality litigation, enforcement phase

description: Enforcement phase of the “Les Amis de la Terre” litigation: on a fresh application by the environmental associations, the Conseil d'État assessed the state of compliance with the NO2 and PM10 obligations imposed by the judgments of 2017, 2020, 2021 and 2022, reviewing the measures put in place by the French State under the atmosphere protection plans (PPA) of Paris, Lyon and Marseille.
outcome: The Conseil d'État held its 2017 decision executed as regards PM10 and, for NO2, in all zones except Paris and Lyon, and liquidated two reduced penalty payments of EUR 5 million each, EUR 10 million in total, for the two six-month periods from 12 July 2022 to 12 July 2023. The penalty payments liquidated in 2021, 2022 and 2023 amount to EUR 40 million in total (10 + 20 + 10), allocated mostly to public bodies (in 2023: ADEME EUR 3.3 million, CEREMA EUR 2.5 million, ANSES EUR 2 million, INERIS EUR 1 million) and to air quality monitoring associations, with EUR 10,000 to Les Amis de la Terre France.
